note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CRO 8; A06b CRO 8; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 8 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Croatia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Croatia for 8 years immediately before the application. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of another citizenship, unless the person is stateless (a statement is sufficient if the other country does not allow renouncing citizenship, or places conditions which cannot be fulfiled) or is the spouse of a citizen (see A08). ... n.a.
